    Translation

    5444. Fayrūz al-Daylamī al-Yamānī: Companion with multiple reports; he killed al-Aswad, who claimed prophethood during the Prophet's lifetime. Died during ʿUthmān's reign, or, according to another account, under Muʿāwiya after 50 AH. [4]

    Taqrīb al-Tahdhīb no. 5444, ed. ʿAwwāma, p. 448
